input.request: Build Access Pass, a renewable onchain subscription page. Token name: Access Pass. Token symbol: PASS. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. AccessPass lets a publisher create a bytes32 plan with a fixed PASS price and uint256 duration; subscribers buy or renew their own pass, and anyone reads whether an address is active at the current timestamp. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to create plans, subscribe, renew and verify access.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Publishers create plans and subscribers renew to keep access; expiry is evaluated when read, so no automated caller is needed.

draft.objective: Build and review PASS and AccessPass, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live subscription-pass website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply PASS and renewable publisher plans.
Test plan ownership, duration, renewal boundaries, payment, and active-pass reads.
Independently adversarially review subscription accounting and authorization.
Build the live wallet-connected plan and renewal page.
